paths.description: As of 4.0, alias=None is required in the signature of django.db.models.Expression.get_group_by_cols() subclasses. Custom Expression subclasses that override get_group_by_cols() without an alias=None parameter in the signature no longer meet the required signature after the upgrade.

Update each override's signature to include alias=None, i.e. get_group_by_cols(self, alias=None).
